form.label: CoolaShaker - Datacenter Infrastructure
form.description: Real-time monitoring of datacenter environmental and power systems

search.query: index=demo_infra location=$location_token$ sensor_type=temperature | fields _time location zone sensor_id value_celsius threshold_warning threshold_critical status
index=demo_infra location=$location_token$ sensor_type=power | fields _time location circuit sensor_id value_kw capacity_kw utilization_pct pue voltage_v
index=demo_infra location=$location_token$ sensor_type=cooling | fields _time location device_id supply_temp_celsius return_temp_celsius fan_speed_pct cooling_capacity_kw airflow_cfm status
index=demo_infra location=$location_token$ sensor_type=ups | fields _time location device_id battery_charge_pct load_pct runtime_minutes input_voltage output_voltage status

| stats avg(value_celsius) as avg_temp | eval avg_temp=round(avg_temp, 1) | eval range=case( avg_temp <= 22, "low", avg_temp <= 25, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_temp low=0-22 elevated=22-25 severe=25-50
| search sensor_id=*-power-total | stats latest(value_kw) as current_power | eval current_power=round(current_power, 1)

| search sensor_id=*-power-total | stats avg(pue) as avg_pue | eval avg_pue=round(avg_pue, 2) | eval range=case( avg_pue <= 1.5, "low", avg_pue <= 1.8, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_pue low=0-1.5 elevated=1.5-1.8 severe=1.8-3.0

| stats avg(battery_charge_pct) as avg_charge | eval avg_charge=round(avg_charge, 1) | eval range=case( avg_charge >= 95, "low", avg_charge >= 80, "elevated", 1=1, "severe") | rangemap field=avg_charge low=95-100 elevated=80-95 severe=0-80
| search circuit!=datacenter_total | timechart span=5m avg(value_kw) by circuit
| timechart span=5m avg(supply_temp_celsius) as "Supply Temp (°C)", avg(return_temp_celsius) as "Return Temp (°C)", avg(fan_speed_pct) as "Fan Speed (%)" by device_id
| timechart span=5m avg(battery_charge_pct) as "Battery Charge %", avg(load_pct) as "Load %" by device_id

| stats latest(value_celsius) as "Current Temp", avg(value_celsius) as "Avg Temp", max(value_celsius) as "Max Temp", latest(threshold_warning) as "Warning", latest(threshold_critical) as "Critical", latest(status) as "Status" by location zone sensor_id | eval "Current Temp"=round('Current Temp', 1), "Avg Temp"=round('Avg Temp', 1), "Max Temp"=round('Max Temp', 1) | sort location zone | rename location as Location, zone as Zone, sensor_id as "Sensor ID"

| stats latest(value_kw) as "Current (kW)", avg(value_kw) as "Avg (kW)", latest(utilization_pct) as "Utilization %", latest(voltage_v) as "Voltage (V)" by location circuit sensor_id | eval "Current (kW)"=round('Current (kW)', 1), "Avg (kW)"=round('Avg (kW)', 1), "Utilization %"=round('Utilization %', 1), "Voltage (V)"=round('Voltage (V)', 0) | sort location circuit | rename location as Location, circuit as Circuit, sensor_id as "Sensor ID"

| stats latest(battery_charge_pct) as "Battery %", latest(load_pct) as "Load %", latest(runtime_minutes) as "Runtime (min)", latest(input_voltage) as "Input (V)", latest(output_voltage) as "Output (V)", latest(status) as "Status" by location device_id | eval "Battery %"=round('Battery %', 1), "Load %"=round('Load %', 1), "Runtime (min)"=round('Runtime (min)', 0), "Input (V)"=round('Input (V)', 0), "Output (V)"=round('Output (V)', 0) | sort location device_id | rename location as Location, device_id as "Device ID"

index=demo_infra location=$location_token$ sensor_type=humidity | stats latest(value_pct) as "Current %", avg(value_pct) as "Avg %", latest(threshold_min) as "Min Threshold", latest(threshold_max) as "Max Threshold", latest(status) as "Status" by location zone sensor_id | eval "Current %"=round('Current %', 1), "Avg %"=round('Avg %', 1) | sort location zone | rename location as Location, zone as Zone, sensor_id as "Sensor ID"

| stats latest(supply_temp_celsius) as "Supply Temp", latest(return_temp_celsius) as "Return Temp", latest(fan_speed_pct) as "Fan Speed %", latest(cooling_capacity_kw) as "Capacity (kW)", latest(status) as "Status" by location device_id | eval "Supply Temp"=round('Supply Temp', 1), "Return Temp"=round('Return Temp', 1), "Fan Speed %"=round('Fan Speed %', 1), "Capacity (kW)"=round('Capacity (kW)', 1) | sort location device_id | rename location as Location, device_id as "Device ID"
